"""Reports CSV exporter. Implement export_csv to satisfy TASK.txt."""


def export_csv(rows, columns):
    """Export mappings in column order as RFC 4180 CSV, including the header.

    rows: iterable of mappings.
    columns: ordered iterable of unique string column names (may be a
        one-shot generator).

    Returns a str with a CSV header followed by one record per row, using
    comma delimiters, CRLF record endings, minimal quoting, and doubled
    quotes. Missing fields and None become empty strings; other values are
    converted with str(). Embedded CR/LF and Unicode are preserved. Inputs
    are not mutated.
    """
    cols = list(columns)
    seen = set()
    for name in cols:
        if not isinstance(name, str):
            raise ValueError("column names must be strings: %r" % (name,))
        if name in seen:
            raise ValueError("duplicate column name: %r" % (name,))
        seen.add(name)

    def render(value):
        if value is None:
            return ""
        text = value if isinstance(value, str) else str(value)
        if any(ch in text for ch in (",", '"', "\r", "\n")):
            return '"' + text.replace('"', '""') + '"'
        return text

    lines = [",".join(cols)]
    for row in rows:
        lines.append(",".join(render(row.get(name)) for name in cols))
    return "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"

"""Reports CSV exporter. Implement export_csv to satisfy TASK.txt."""


def export_csv(rows, columns):
    """Export mappings in column order as RFC 4180 CSV, including the header.

    rows: iterable of mappings.
    columns: ordered iterable of unique string column names (may be a
        one-shot generator).

    Returns a str with a CSV header followed by one record per row, using
    comma delimiters, CRLF record endings, minimal quoting, and doubled
    quotes. Missing fields and None become empty strings; other values are
    converted with str(). Embedded CR/LF and Unicode are preserved. Inputs
    are not mutated.
    """
    cols = list(columns)
    seen = set()
    for name in cols:
        if not isinstance(name, str):
            raise ValueError("column names must be strings: %r" % (name,))
        if name in seen:
            raise ValueError("duplicate column name: %r" % (name,))
        seen.add(name)

    def render(value):
        if value is None:
            return ""
        text = value if isinstance(value, str) else str(value)
        if any(ch in text for ch in (",", '"', "\r", "\n")):
            return '"' + text.replace('"', '""') + '"'
        return text

    lines = [",".join(render(name) for name in cols)]
    if cols:
        for row in rows:
            lines.append(",".join(render(row.get(name)) for name in cols))
    return "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"
